bullets.text: Samsung's Exciting July Launch - **Samsung** is set to unveil its **Galaxy Glasses** and **Galaxy Watch 9** at a London event.
Android's Anti-Doomscrolling Feature - **Google** introduces **Pause Point** to help users manage app distractions effectively.
Custom Widgets on Android - **Google** launches **Create My Widget**, allowing users to design personalized widgets using natural language.
Enhanced Android Security - **Google** rolls out **Intrusion Logging** to help detect spyware attacks on Android devices.
AI-Powered Pothole Solutions - **Samsara** uses AI to help cities detect and manage potholes more efficiently.
David Attenborough Tribute on Google - **Google Search** celebrates **Sir David Attenborough's** 100th birthday with a special Easter egg.
AI Legal Services Growth - **Anthropic** expands its legal chatbot features to automate tasks for law firms.
Apple's Camera App Customization - **iOS 27** may introduce extensive customization options for the **Camera app**.
Meta's New Teen Features - **Meta** enhances parental controls by notifying parents about their teens' interests on **Instagram**.
